answer: A reputation grove grows slowly: every agent earns trust only through verified work recorded over time, like rings in a tree, so a fresh fake identity starts with no history and no credit. When payments or tasks require a minimum stake of earned reputation plus a small deposit, a sybil swarm must pay the same cost per identity. A sonnet of praise costs nothing; a violet thread of consistent, costly, checkable history cannot be faked cheaply at scale.
